label: Touch and Go
lede: A Sacramento band named after the click consonants in a movie subtitle moved to New York, wrote a nine-minute song about Rudy Giuliani's war on dancing, and has been jamming its way around the festival circuit ever since.

hero.by: !!! at Positivus festival, Latvia, July 2013. Wikimedia Commons

eras.title: Three clicks of the tongue
eras.text: In Sacramento, members of Black Liquorice, Pope Smashers and the hardcore band Yah Mos came home from a joint tour wanting to make people dance. They brought in the Yah Mos singer and named the result after something you can't spell.

years.h: Two Sacramento bands merge on tour and add a hardcore singer
years.p: Black Liquorice and Pope Smashers fold their disco-funk into something louder, with [[Nic Offer|2eb42fe7-fa04-49db-8cb2-3e3685599eff]] of the Yah Mos up front. Warp lists an eight-piece first line-up with [[Mikel Gius|2bdc8dd9-c070-4089-8d64-4bab640f9fdf]] on drums.
years.xp:
That first line-up, per Warp: Offer on vocals, [[Mario Andreoni|8c8f98cf-12fb-4237-8193-a7a1d1f8f80e]] and [[Tyler Pope|ea4d96b4-aeb9-48f9-b4b8-32180aed5f2b]] on guitar, [[Justin Van Der Volgen|63cd48cf-b41e-4e20-821b-f0c0f1e361d1]] on bass, [[Dan Gorman|3f91ea18-bbbd-4fde-bae6-cda37959b444]] on trumpet and percussion, [[Allan Wilson|e3949012-48d8-4b15-81f3-691ad5a2356c]] on saxophone and percussion, Gius on drums and Jason Racine on percussion. [[John Pugh|bd1345a6-e06a-402a-a48f-954082183dce]] sang and drummed on the early records too.

Offer has named Depeche Mode and OMD as influences.

years.h: The name comes from The Gods Must Be Crazy
years.p: The film's subtitles printed the San people's click consonants as exclamation points. The band says any one-syllable sound repeated three times will do; the world settled on "chk chk chk."
years.xp: Offer told the Agit Reader he'd keep the original idea if he could rename it: just three clicks of the tongue.

years.h: A split with Out Hud, which is mostly the same people
years.p: Lab Series Vol. 2 on Gold Standard Laboratories pairs !!! with Out Hud, the electronic band Offer, Pope and Van Der Volgen also play in.

eras.title: Half the band moves to New York
eras.text: Out Hud decided to move to New York and figured !!! would sort itself out. It did, with members on both coasts, and the band's first New York years ran straight into the city's dance-floor crackdown.

years.h: The debut album, on Gold Standard Laboratories
years.p: Seven songs, first out on vinyl, produced by the band and Van Der Volgen. The wide CD release follows on June 19, 2001.

years.h: Offer lands in New York and catches Animal Collective at Mercury Lounge
years.p: People told Out Hud there was nothing happening in New York. Within a month Offer was at a bill with the Moldy Peaches, [[Animal Collective|0c751690-c784-4a4f-b1e4-c1de27d47581]], an early Gang Gang Dance and [[Black Dice|d8f9a4bd-ec27-4e29-8b3e-b8bdb62f950e]].
years.xp: "We made the decision as Outhud to move to New York and figured everything would somehow work out for !!!," Offer told the Agit Reader. For the band's first seven years, he told Electronic Beats, every show opened with a jam; the longest ever ran about three and a half hours.

yt: 'Me and Giuliani Down by the School Yard'
years.h: 'Me and Giuliani Down by the School Yard', nine minutes, mixed for clubs
years.p: Touch and Go (TG247) and Warp put out the 9:03 single, aimed at Mayor Rudy Giuliani's enforcement of New York's cabaret law against dancing. It reaches No. 84 in the UK.
years.xp:
Hearing the Rapture's DFA single in clubs gave Offer the idea. "We definitely mixed 'Me and Giuliani Down by the Schoolyard' so it could be played in a club," he told Electronic Beats, "and then when it did it was, like, 'Woah!'"

Until 2017, any New York venue where people danced legally needed a cabaret license. The B-side is a 9:14 remix of 'Intensifieder'.

eras.title: Touch and Go, Warp and a Nashville basement
eras.text: The second album came out on Touch and Go in America and Warp everywhere else, and turned the band into a festival act. Those years also brought the death of founding drummer Mikel Gius and, by the end, a singer's exit.

yt: 'Hello? Is This Thing On?', official video
'Hello? Is This Thing On?' at Rescue Rooms, Nottingham, 2004
years.h: Louden Up Now goes to No. 4 on the dance chart
years.p: Touch and Go in the US, Warp in Europe. AllMusic calls it a "modern-day agit-pop indie dance-rock classic"; Pitchfork gives it 7.0. Singles: 'Pardon My Freedom' and 'Hello? Is This Thing On?'

years.h: !!! plays Coachella the year of Louden Up Now
years.p: The band is on the 2004 bill in Indio. Up front, Offer is known for dancing through every set in a pair of short blue shorts.

years.h: !!! covers the Magnetic Fields and Nate Dogg on one EP
years.p: 'Take Ecstasy with Me' and 'Get Up' come out as a covers release.

years.h: Out Hud ends as Pope goes to LCD Soundsystem
years.p: Pope leaves Out Hud for [[LCD Soundsystem|2aaf7396-6ab8-40f3-9776-a41c42c8e26b]], and a September show is billed as possibly Out Hud's last. He keeps playing in !!! and is on Myth Takes.
years.xp: Offer, to Electronic Beats in 2013: James Murphy's crew "stole Tyler," but he doesn't think DFA was influenced by !!!. "I think he always kind of viewed us as competition."

years.h: Original drummer Mikel Gius is killed riding his bike
years.p: Gius is struck by a car while cycling near Sacramento. The Sacramento Bee reported it under "Orangevale bicyclist killed."

years.h: Halfway between Sacramento and New York: a basement in Nashville
years.p: With half the band on each coast, !!! records Myth Takes in a "dirty, dingy" rented-house basement in Nashville, with [[Jerry Fuchs|13b24fba-4352-435d-949f-d06adb6d9c6c]] on drums.

years.h: Myth Takes, the first album for Warp alone
years.p: A high-school marching band turns up on the record. Pitchfork gives it 8.0, and it reaches No. 195 on the Billboard 200 and No. 36 in Japan.
years.xp: Offer and Andreoni took the nine-piece's story to NPR's All Things Considered that May, from the name to the marching band. 'Heart of Hearts' went out first as a free download and a picture disc.

years.h: Shannon Funchess sings on the summer tour
years.p: With Pugh off the road, Shannon Funchess fills in for most of 2007's dates.

years.h: John Pugh leaves for Free Blood
years.p: The singer and drummer quits to concentrate on his own band, Free Blood. Pitchfork ran it on October 11.

eras.title: A drummer lost, a record made in Berlin
eras.text: Besides !!!, Fuchs drummed for The Juan MacLean, Maserati and Turing Machine and played live with LCD Soundsystem. After his death the band made its next album in the basement of a Berlin club.

years.h: Jerry Fuchs dies in a Williamsburg elevator shaft
years.p: At a fundraiser in a Williamsburg building, Fuchs and a friend try to jump from a stuck freight elevator to the fifth floor. His clothing catches, and he falls down the shaft. He was 34.
years.xp:
The Guardian, citing the New York Post: the friend landed safely, Fuchs was pulled backward and fell, and he died in hospital at 3:30am.

"He was hands-down the best drummer I have ever played with or seen," Juan MacLean wrote. LCD Soundsystem dedicated This Is Happening to him.

years.h: Two months in a Berlin club basement
years.p: Offer and Andreoni's loops get jammed into songs in Berlin, with new producer Eric Broucek. Offer's summary: "Deeper, darker, denser, doper."
years.xp:
"Working with new producer Eric Broucek was a bit like having a new member with opinions both good and bad," Offer told the Agit Reader, and some of the fights made the best parts. The string players on 'The Most Certain Sure' were in and out in about an hour.

Critics were mixed: 67 on Metacritic.

eras.title: Warp lifers
eras.text: With Pope gone, Rafael Cohen of Supersystem took over bass and songwriting, and !!! settled into a steady run on Warp: an album every two years or so, and the festival summers that had come to feel normal.

years.h: Spoon's Jim Eno helps on Thr!!!er
years.p: Cohen's first album with the band, with Paul Quattrone on drums. Offer describes songs built from jams, Cohen's instrumentals, his own beats, and a few machines nobody understood.
years.xp: Offer told Electronic Beats he likes the 'Blue Monday' theory: use machines you don't understand and keep the happy accidents. A synth part in 'Accept Death' stayed because Andreoni said "That sounds cool."

years.h: Album six, As If, led by 'All U Writers'
years.p: The singles: 'All U Writers', 'Freedom! '15' and 'Sick Ass Moon'.

years.h: Shake the Shudder keeps the Warp run going
years.p: The seventh album, with the singles 'The One 2' and 'Dancing Is the Best Revenge'.

years.h: Wallop, then the Certified Heavy Kats EP
years.p: The eighth album, with 'Serbia Drums'. The Certified Heavy Kats EP follows in July 2020.

years.h: Let It Be Blue lands 26 years after the merger
years.p: The ninth album, on Warp. In October the band is in London, playing Heaven.
